title: Construct only selected endpoint axes

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

objective: Delete unconditional construction and validation of TypedAxis values for Fourfold planes that are not endpoints of any selected relation block, while retaining full canonical snapshot membership for every endpoint axis that is selected.

decision.summary: Reuse the already-final selected RelationSignature tuple to derive the endpoint-plane set, then construct TypedAxis only for those endpoint planes.
decision.why_gardening: The compiler already knows the exact selected signatures before axis materialization. Constructing all four axes regardless of selection duplicated validation and tuple/label work for unselected planes. No new selector, cache, index, backend, compiler, store, API or authority was needed.

behavior: derive selected_planes from selected RelationSignature endpoint planes
construct TypedAxis only when the Fourfold plane is in selected_planes
retain planes[index].node_ids unchanged as the canonical complete label set for each constructed axis
